_readme: Operator-gathered evidence for one frozen release SHA, in the shape
scripts/release_gate.py consumes: one key per gate, each carrying the
release_sha it is bound to. Keys are ABSENT for gates nobody has proven —
check_external reports a missing key as UNVERIFIED, which blocks, and that
is the honest answer. Never add a key to make a gate go green.
ccbdfe0 is the first SHA today where Render and Vercel are running the same
commit. #745 (c549ffb) never got a deploy of its own: a dispatched refresh
held its check-run open, and ccbdfe0 carried its code up instead. See
docs/RELEASE.md section 3, 'A scheduled workflow can hold the backend deploy'.
OMITTED ON PURPOSE, and why:
restore  - Supabase's only restore path provisions a NEW billed project.
That is the account owner's call, not something to spend for
a drill without asking. Backups exist and are listed below;
recovery from them has still never been exercised.
dead_man - migration 032 is committed and CI-replayed but NOT applied to
production; ops-scan confirmed it at 2026-08-14T12:19:38Z by
opening 'Dead man's switch is not installed' (urgent). The
design being correct is not evidence that the switch is armed.
Apply 032, run the drill in docs/RELEASE.md section 3, then
record the observed row values here.
rollback - never exercised on this project. A rollback that has not been
rehearsed is a plan, not a capability.
open_incidents is 11 and therefore FAILS this gate. Every one is real and
none has been resolved to make the ledger prettier: 1 professor-tracking
coverage drift, 9 degraded jhu/princeton/stanford sources from the 06:25
refresh, and the not-installed dead man above.

POST /api/matches/view answered 200 for five simultaneous distinct profiles (6.78s, 6.78s, 10.93s, 11.10s, 13.94s) — the same shape that returned 503 MATCH_BUSY in 2.65s before #744. GET /api/opportunities/stats/summary returns 200 with 132,524 total / 129,761 active. The browser walk on the immediately preceding build (0656768 backend, c549ffb frontend, code-identical to this SHA except the corpus and #747/#748/#749) covered profile -> Generate -> 125,814 ranked results with per-professor cards -> Email Professor drafting a real AI cold email with its refine panel -> Tracker rendering saved items. Honest limit: that walk predates this exact SHA, and the capacity fix converts an error into a wait, not into speed — one match worker means a burst of twelve students leaves the last one waiting ~27s.
